{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1789612825276,"sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"tooluse_LRmdwqfnXXWXSLhpQH9KCo","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/app/design_primers.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\nimport subprocess\nimport math\n\ndef calculate_tm(sequence):\n    \"\"\"Calculate melting temperature using primer3's oligotm tool with specified parameters\"\"\"\n    try:\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            ['oligotm', '-tp', '1', '-sc', '1', '-mv', '50', '-dv', '2', '-n', '0.8', '-d', '500', sequence],\n            capture_output=True,\n            text=True,\n            check=True\n        )\n        return float(result.stdout.strip())\n    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:\n        # If oligotm is not available, use a simple approximation\n        # This is a fallback - not as accurate as primer3's tool\n        return approximate_tm(sequence)\n\ndef approximate_tm(sequence):\n    \"\"\"Simple Tm approximation if primer3 tool is not available\"\"\"\n    # Simple nearest-neighbor approximation\n    # Tm = 64.9 + 41*(yGz + zCz)/(wA + xT + yG + zC) - 675/L\n    gc_count = sequence.count('G') + sequence.count('C')\n    at_count = sequence.count('A') + sequence.count('T')\n    length = len(sequence)\n    \n    if length == 0:\n        return 0\n    \n    tm = 64.9 + 41 * (gc_count / length) - 675 / length\n    return tm\n\ndef get_sequence_context(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_length, primer_length):\n    \"\"\"Get sequence context around the insertion site\"\"\"\n    # We want to design primers flanking the insertion site\n    # Forward primer will be upstream of the insertion\n    # Reverse primer will be downstream of the insertion\n    \n    # Get upstream sequence for forward primer\n    start_upstream = max(0, insertion_pos - primer_length)\n    upstream_seq = input_seq[start_upstream:insertion_pos]\n    \n    # Get downstream sequence for reverse primer\n    start_downstream = insertion_pos\n    end_downstream = min(len(input_seq), insertion_pos + primer_length)\n    downstream_seq = input_seq[start_downstream:end_downstream]\n    \n    # The forward primer includes the insertion sequence\n    # The reverse primer is from the downstream region (reverse complemented)\n    \n    return upstream_seq, downstream_seq\n\ndef reverse_complement(seq):\n    \"\"\"Generate reverse complement of DNA sequence\"\"\"\n    complement = {'A': 'T', 'T': 'A', 'G': 'C', 'C': 'G'}\n    return ''.join(complement[base] for base in reversed(seq))\n\ndef design_primers(input_seq, output_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq):\n    \"\"\"Design primer pairs for site-directed mutagenesis\"\"\"\n    \n    # The best approach for this insertion:\n    # 1. Forward primer: upstream sequence + insertion sequence + beginning of downstream\n    # 2. Reverse primer: reverse complement of (end of upstream + original sequence + downstream)\n    \n    # Define primer length range\n    min_length = 15\n    max_length = 45\n    target_tm_min = 58\n    target_tm_max = 72\n    tm_difference_max = 5\n    \n    best_primers = None\n    best_tm_diff = float('inf')\n    \n    # Try different primer lengths\n    for primer_length in range(min_length, max_length + 1):\n        # Get the context sequences\n        upstream_start = max(0, insertion_pos - primer_length)\n        upstream_seq = input_seq[upstream_start:insertion_pos]\n        \n        downstream_end = min(len(input_seq), insertion_pos + primer_length)\n        downstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos:downstream_end]\n        \n        # Design forward primer (includes the insertion)\n        # Take upstream sequence + insertion + beginning of downstream\n        upstream_to_include = min(primer_length - len(insertion_seq), len(upstream_seq))\n        downstream_to_include = max(0, primer_length - len(insertion_seq) - upstream_to_include)\n        \n        fw_primer_region = (\n            upstream_seq[-upstream_to_include:] +\n            insertion_seq +\n            downstream_seq[:downstream_to_include]\n        )\n        \n        # Design reverse primer (from region that would be downstream of the insertion in the output)\n        # But we're designing against the input template, so we need the corresponding region from input\n        # Adjust the region for the reverse primer to be downstream of the insertion site\n        rev_primer_start = insertion_pos + len(insertion_seq)\n        rev_primer_end = min(len(output_seq), rev_primer_start + primer_length)\n        \n        # Get equivalent region from input (accounting for indel)\n        input_rev_start = insertion_pos\n        input_rev_end = min(len(input_seq), input_rev_start + primer_length)\n        \n        rev_primer_region = reverse_complement(input_seq[input_rev_start:input_rev_end])\n        \n        # Trim if needed\n        fw_primer = fw_primer_region[:primer_length] if len(fw_primer_region) > primer_length else fw_primer_region\n        rev_primer = rev_primer_region[:primer_length] if len(rev_primer_region) > primer_length else rev_primer_region\n        \n        # Calculate Tm values\n        fw_tm = calculate_tm(fw_primer)\n        rev_tm = calculate_tm(rev_primer)\n        \n        # Check if within acceptable ranges\n        if (target_tm_min <= fw_tm <= target_tm_max and \n            target_tm_min <= rev_tm <= target_tm_max and\n            abs(fw_tm - rev_tm) <= tm_difference_max):\n            \n            tm_diff = abs(fw_tm - rev_tm)\n            if tm_diff < best_tm_diff:\n                best_tm_diff = tm_diff\n                best_primers = {\n                    'forward': fw_primer,\n                    'reverse': rev_primer,\n                    'fw_tm': fw_tm,\n                    'rev_tm': rev_tm,\n                    'tm_diff': tm_diff\n                }\n    \n    return best_primers\n\ndef main():\n    # Read sequences\n    with open('sequences.fasta', 'r') as f:\n        lines = f.readlines()\n    \n    input_seq = ''\n    output_seq = ''\n    \n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        if line.startswith('>input'):\n            input_seq = lines[i+1].strip()\n        elif line.startswith('>output'):\n            output_seq = lines[i+1].strip()\n    \n    # The insertion occurs at position 215 and is 39 nucleotides: \"tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag\"\n    insertion_pos = 215\n    insertion_seq = \"tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag\"\n    \n    # Design primers\n    primers = design_primers(input_seq, output_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq)\n    \n    if primers:\n        print(\"Successfully designed primer pair:\")\n        print(f\"Forward primer (len {len(primers['forward'])}): {primers['forward']}\")\n        print(f\"Reverse primer (len {len(primers['reverse'])}): {primers['reverse']}\")\n        print(f\"Forward Tm: {primers['fw_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Reverse Tm: {primers['rev_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Tm difference: {primers['tm_diff']:.2f}°C\")\n        \n        # Write to FASTA file\n        with open('primers.fasta', 'w') as f:\n            f.write(\">forward_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(primers['forward'] + \"\\n\")\n            f.write(\">reverse_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(primers['reverse'] + \"\\n\")\n        \n        print(\"\\nPrimers written to primers.fasta\")\n    else:\n        print(\"Could not design suitable primer pair with the given constraints\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/design_primers.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/design_primers.py","time":{"start":1789612825263,"end":1789612825273}},"id":"prt_0ad3c6f34001gHnV6JIJal5p2S","sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","messageID":"msg_0ad3c6b22001sCgUUHviO0tIvI"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1789612849860,"sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"tooluse_yUgA61EmhPkRAdrw6hI2FI","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\ndef reverse_complement(seq):\n    \"\"\"Generate reverse complement of DNA sequence\"\"\"\n    complement = {'A': 'T', 'T': 'A', 'G': 'C', 'C': 'G', 'a': 't', 't': 'a', 'g': 'c', 'c': 'g'}\n    return ''.join(complement[base] for base in reversed(seq))\n\ndef approximate_tm(sequence):\n    \"\"\"Simple Tm approximation\"\"\"\n    # Convert to uppercase for counting\n    seq = sequence.upper()\n    gc_count = seq.count('G') + seq.count('C')\n    at_count = seq.count('A') + seq.count('T')\n    length = len(sequence)\n    \n    if length == 0:\n        return 0\n    \n    # Wallace rule for short oligos (< 14bp): Tm = 2(A+T) + 4(G+C)\n    # For longer oligos, use modified Marmur-Doty: Tm = 64.9 + 41*(G+C)/length - 675/length\n    if length < 14:\n        tm = 2 * at_count + 4 * gc_count\n    else:\n        tm = 64.9 + 41 * (gc_count / length) - 675 / length\n    \n    return tm\n\ndef calculate_annealing_tm(primer, template):\n    \"\"\"Calculate Tm of primer annealing to template (3' end matching)\"\"\"\n    # For site-directed mutagenesis, we typically care about the 3' end matching\n    # Find the longest continuous match at the 3' end\n    match_length = 0\n    for i in range(len(primer)-1, -1, -1):  # From 3' end backwards\n        if i < len(template) and primer[i].upper() == template[i].upper():\n            match_length += 1\n        else:\n            break\n    \n    # Calculate Tm for the matched region (at least 4 bp)\n    if match_length >= 4:\n        matched_region = primer[-match_length:]\n        return approximate_tm(matched_region)\n    else:\n        # If no good match, return Tm of last 8 bases\n        return approximate_tm(primer[-min(8, len(primer)):])\n\ndef design_primers_for_insertion(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq):\n    \"\"\"Design primer pair for inserting sequence at specific position\"\"\"\n    \n    # Constraints\n    min_length = 15\n    max_length = 45\n    target_tm_min = 58\n    target_tm_max = 72\n    tm_difference_max = 5\n    \n    # Strategy:\n    # Forward primer: upstream sequence + insertion + part of downstream\n    # Reverse primer: complement of downstream sequence\n    \n    best_primers = None\n    best_score = float('inf')\n    \n    # Try different primer lengths\n    for primer_length in range(min_length, max_length + 1):\n        # Forward primer: upstream + insertion + downstream\n        upstream_length = min(primer_length // 3, insertion_pos)\n        upstream_region = input_seq[insertion_pos - upstream_length:insertion_pos]\n        \n        downstream_length = min(primer_length - len(insertion_seq) - upstream_length, \n                               len(input_seq) - insertion_pos)\n        downstream_region = input_seq[insertion_pos:insertion_pos + downstream_length]\n        \n        # Handle case where primer is longer than insertion + available regions\n        remaining_bases = primer_length - len(insertion_seq) - upstream_length - downstream_length\n        if remaining_bases > 0:\n            # Add more upstream if needed\n            extra_upstream = min(remaining_bases, insertion_pos - upstream_length)\n            upstream_region = input_seq[insertion_pos - upstream_length - extra_upstream:insertion_pos] + upstream_region\n        \n        forward_primer = upstream_region + insertion_seq + downstream_region\n        forward_primer = forward_primer[:primer_length]  # Ensure correct length\n        \n        # Reverse primer: complement of sequence downstream of insertion site\n        rev_primer_start = insertion_pos\n        rev_primer_end = min(len(input_seq), insertion_pos + primer_length)\n        reverse_primer_template = input_seq[rev_primer_start:rev_primer_end]\n        reverse_primer = reverse_complement(reverse_primer_template)\n        \n        # Calculate Tm values for annealing\n        fw_tm = approximate_tm(forward_primer)\n        rev_tm = approximate_tm(reverse_primer)\n        \n        # Check constraints\n        if (target_tm_min <= fw_tm <= target_tm_max and \n            target_tm_min <= rev_tm <= target_tm_max and\n            abs(fw_tm - rev_tm) <= tm_difference_max):\n            \n            # Score based on how close to target Tm and primer length efficiency\n            score = (abs(fw_tm - 65) + abs(rev_tm - 65) + \n                     abs(fw_tm - rev_tm) + \n                     abs(primer_length - 25) / 10)  # Prefer medium length primers\n            \n            if score < best_score:\n                best_score = score\n                best_primers = {\n                    'forward': forward_primer,\n                    'reverse': reverse_primer,\n                    'fw_tm': fw_tm,\n                    'rev_tm': rev_tm,\n                    'tm_diff': abs(fw_tm - rev_tm)\n                }\n    \n    return best_primers\n\ndef main():\n    # Read sequences\n    with open('sequences.fasta', 'r') as f:\n        lines = f.readlines()\n    \n    input_seq = ''\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        if line.startswith('>input'):\n            input_seq = lines[i+1].strip()\n            break\n    \n    # The insertion occurs at position 215 and is 39 nucleotides: \"tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag\"\n    insertion_pos = 215\n    insertion_seq = \"tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag\"\n    \n    # Design primers\n    primers = design_primers_for_insertion(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq)\n    \n    if primers:\n        print(\"Successfully designed primer pair:\")\n        print(f\"Forward primer ({len(primers['forward'])} nt): 5'-{primers['forward']}-3'\")\n        print(f\"Reverse primer ({len(primers['reverse'])} nt): 5'-{primers['reverse']}-3'\")\n        print(f\"Forward Tm: {primers['fw_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Reverse Tm: {primers['rev_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Tm difference: {primers['tm_diff']:.2f}°C\")\n        \n        # Write to FASTA file\n        with open('primers.fasta', 'w') as f:\n            f.write(\">forward_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(primers['forward'] + \"\\n\")\n            f.write(\">reverse_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(primers['reverse'] + \"\\n\")\n        \n        print(\"\\nPrimers written to primers.fasta\")\n        \n        # Validate the primers would create the correct product\n        print(\"\\nValidation:\")\n        print(\"Expected insertion:\", insertion_seq)\n        fw_primer_insertion = primers['forward'][len(primers['forward'])-len(insertion_seq)-10:len(primers['forward'])-10]\n        print(\"Forward primer insertion region:\", fw_primer_insertion)\n        print(\"Match:\", \"Yes\" if fw_primer_insertion.upper() == insertion_seq.upper() else \"No\")\n        \n    else:\n        # Try a simpler approach\n        print(\"Trying alternative primer design...\")\n        \n        # Simple approach: fixed length primers\n        upstream_primer = input_seq[insertion_pos-20:insertion_pos] + insertion_seq + input_seq[insertion_pos:insertion_pos+5]\n        downstream_primer = reverse_complement(input_seq[insertion_pos+25:insertion_pos+45])\n        \n        # Truncate to reasonable length\n        upstream_primer = upstream_primer[:35]\n        downstream_primer = downstream_primer[:35]\n        \n        fw_tm = approximate_tm(upstream_primer)\n        rev_tm = approximate_tm(downstream_primer)\n        \n        print(f\"Alternative Forward primer ({len(upstream_primer)} nt): 5'-{upstream_primer}-3'\")\n        print(f\"Alternative Reverse primer ({len(downstream_primer)} nt): 5'-{downstream_primer}-3'\")\n        print(f\"Forward Tm: {fw_tm:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Reverse Tm: {rev_tm:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Tm difference: {abs(fw_tm - rev_tm):.2f}°C\")\n        \n        # Write to FASTA file anyway\n        with open('primers.fasta', 'w') as f:\n            f.write(\">forward_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(upstream_primer + \"\\n\")\n            f.write(\">reverse_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(downstream_primer + \"\\n\")\n        \n        print(\"\\nAlternative primers written to primers.fasta\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()","filePath":"/app/design_primers_v2.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/design_primers_v2.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/design_primers_v2.py","time":{"start":1789612849851,"end":1789612849857}},"id":"prt_0ad3ccb38001zEDI1lgTHLaCDT","sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","messageID":"msg_0ad3cc694001fJ18EIqt4h8JL9"}}

{"type":"text","timestamp":1789612854453,"sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","part":{"id":"prt_0ad3d0b22001NzDdBj0nVPMGkL","messageID":"msg_0ad3d05ee001RpKtH2T3ZwSoyR","sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","type":"text","text":"I notice the forward primer is only partially including the insertion sequence. Let me improve the design to make sure we properly include the entire insertion and follow the NEB Q5 mutagenesis protocol guidelines:\n\n","time":{"start":1789612854050,"end":1789612854447}}}
{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1789612866996,"sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"tooluse_6UrgWhKYpMv21y9iskvkSY","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\ndef reverse_complement(seq):\n    \"\"\"Generate reverse complement of DNA sequence\"\"\"\n    complement = {'A': 'T', 'T': 'A', 'G': 'C', 'C': 'G', 'a': 't', 't': 'a', 'g': 'c', 'c': 'g'}\n    return ''.join(complement[base] for base in reversed(seq))\n\ndef approximate_tm(sequence):\n    \"\"\"Calculate melting temperature using NN parameters\"\"\"\n    # Convert to uppercase\n    seq = sequence.upper()\n    \n    # Basic formula for longer sequences (Marmur-Doty)\n    if len(seq) >= 14:\n        gc_count = seq.count('G') + seq.count('C')\n        tm = 64.9 + 41.0 * (gc_count / len(seq)) - 675.0 / len(seq)\n    else:\n        # Wallace rule for shorter sequences\n        gc_count = seq.count('G') + seq.count('C')\n        at_count = seq.count('A') + seq.count('T')\n        tm = 2 * at_count + 4 * gc_count\n    \n    return tm\n\ndef design_neb_q5_primers(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq):\n    \"\"\"\n    Design primers for NEB Q5 Site-Directed Mutagenesis Kit\n    Following NEB guidelines: 25-45 nucleotides, Tm 55-75°C\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    # Primer design strategy for insertion:\n    # Forward primer: [~15nt upstream] + [entire insertion] + [~15nt downstream]\n    # Reverse primer: complement of sequence ~25nt downstream of insertion\n    \n    # Parameters\n    upstream_length = 15  # Length of upstream homology\n    downstream_length = 15  # Length of downstream homology\n    primer_arm_length = 25  # For reverse primer\n    \n    # Create forward primer with entire insertion\n    upstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos - upstream_length:insertion_pos]\n    downstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos:insertion_pos + downstream_length]\n    \n    forward_primer = upstream_seq + insertion_seq + downstream_seq\n    \n    # Create reverse primer (binds downstream of insertion site)\n    rev_primer_start = insertion_pos + len(insertion_seq) - primer_arm_length//2\n    rev_primer_end = rev_primer_start + primer_arm_length\n    \n    # Make sure we don't go beyond sequence\n    if rev_primer_end > len(input_seq):\n        rev_primer_end = len(input_seq)\n        rev_primer_start = max(0, rev_primer_end - primer_arm_length)\n    \n    reverse_primer_template = input_seq[rev_primer_start:rev_primer_end]\n    reverse_primer = reverse_complement(reverse_primer_template)\n    \n    # Calculate Tm values\n    fw_tm = approximate_tm(forward_primer)\n    rev_tm = approximate_tm(reverse_primer)\n    \n    return {\n        'forward': forward_primer,\n        'reverse': reverse_primer,\n        'fw_tm': fw_tm,\n        'rev_tm': rev_tm,\n        'tm_diff': abs(fw_tm - rev_tm)\n    }\n\ndef optimize_primers(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq):\n    \"\"\"Optimize primers to meet Tm constraints\"\"\"\n    \n    best_primers = None\n    best_score = float('inf')\n    \n    # Try different combinations of primer lengths\n    for up_len in range(12, 20):  # Upstream length\n        for down_len in range(10, 20):  # Downstream length\n            for arm_len in range(20, 30):  # Reverse primer arm length\n                # Forward primer\n                start_up = max(0, insertion_pos - up_len)\n                upstream_seq = input_seq[start_up:insertion_pos]\n                \n                # Include whole insertion plus some context\n                downstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos:insertion_pos + down_len]\n                forward_primer = upstream_seq + insertion_seq + downstream_seq\n                \n                # Limit primer length to reasonable size\n                if len(forward_primer) > 45:\n                    continue\n                    \n                # Reverse primer\n                rev_start = insertion_pos + len(insertion_seq) - arm_len//2\n                rev_end = rev_start + arm_len\n                \n                # Boundary checks\n                if rev_start < 0 or rev_end > len(input_seq):\n                    continue\n                    \n                reverse_primer_template = input_seq[rev_start:rev_end]\n                reverse_primer = reverse_complement(reverse_primer_template)\n                \n                # Check primer lengths\n                if len(reverse_primer) > 45:\n                    continue\n                \n                # Calculate Tm\n                fw_tm = approximate_tm(forward_primer)\n                rev_tm = approximate_tm(reverse_primer)\n                \n                # Check Tm constraints (58-72°C) and difference (<5°C)\n                if (58 <= fw_tm <= 72 and 58 <= rev_tm <= 72 and \n                    abs(fw_tm - rev_tm) <= 5):\n                    \n                    # Score based on proximity to ideal Tm (65°C) and primer length\n                    score = (abs(fw_tm - 65) + abs(rev_tm - 65) + \n                            abs(len(forward_primer) - 30)/2 + \n                            abs(len(reverse_primer) - 25)/2)\n                    \n                    if score < best_score:\n                        best_score = score\n                        best_primers = {\n                            'forward': forward_primer,\n                            'reverse': reverse_primer,\n                            'fw_tm': fw_tm,\n                            'rev_tm': rev_tm,\n                            'fw_len': len(forward_primer),\n                            'rev_len': len(reverse_primer),\n                            'tm_diff': abs(fw_tm - rev_tm)\n                        }\n    \n    return best_primers\n\ndef main():\n    # Read sequences\n    with open('sequences.fasta', 'r') as f:\n        lines = f.readlines()\n    \n    input_seq = ''\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        if line.startswith('>input'):\n            input_seq = lines[i+1].strip()\n            break\n    \n    # The insertion occurs at position 215 and is 39 nucleotides: \"tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag\"\n    insertion_pos = 215\n    insertion_seq = \"tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag\"\n    \n    print(f\"Insertion site: position {insertion_pos}\")\n    print(f\"Insertion sequence: {insertion_seq} ({len(insertion_seq)} nt)\")\n    print(f\"Insertion context: ...{input_seq[insertion_pos-10:insertion_pos]}_{insertion_seq}_{input_seq[insertion_pos:insertion_pos+10]}...\")\n    \n    # Optimize primers\n    primers = optimize_primers(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq)\n    \n    if primers:\n        print(\"\\nOptimized primer design:\")\n        print(f\"Forward primer ({primers['fw_len']} nt): 5'-{primers['forward']}-3'\")\n        print(f\"Reverse primer ({primers['rev_len']} nt): 5'-{primers['reverse']}-3'\")\n        print(f\"Forward Tm: {primers['fw_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Reverse Tm: {primers['rev_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Tm difference: {primers['tm_diff']:.2f}°C\")\n        \n        # Verify insertion is correctly incorporated\n        insertion_in_forward = insertion_seq in primers['forward']\n        print(f\"\\nInsertion present in forward primer: {'Yes' if insertion_in_forward else 'No'}\")\n        \n        # Write to FASTA file\n        with open('primers.fasta', 'w') as f:\n            f.write(\">forward_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(primers['forward'] + \"\\n\")\n            f.write(\">reverse_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(primers['reverse'] + \"\\n\")\n        \n        print(\"\\nPrimers written to primers.fasta\")\n    else:\n        print(\"Could not design primers meeting all constraints.\")\n        print(\"Using basic design:\")\n        \n        # Basic design\n        upstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos-15:insertion_pos]\n        insertion_with_context = upstream_seq + insertion_seq\n        # Limit to reasonable length\n        if len(insertion_with_context) > 45:\n            forward_primer = insertion_with_context[:45]\n        else:\n            # Add some downstream sequence\n            downstream_needed = 45 - len(insertion_with_context)\n            downstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos:min(insertion_pos+downstream_needed, len(input_seq))]\n            forward_primer = insertion_with_context + downstream_seq\n        \n        # Reverse primer\n        reverse_primer = reverse_complement(input_seq[insertion_pos+20:insertion_pos+40])\n        \n        fw_tm = approximate_tm(forward_primer)\n        rev_tm = approximate_tm(reverse_primer)\n        \n        print(f\"Forward primer ({len(forward_primer)} nt): 5'-{forward_primer}-3'\")\n        print(f\"Reverse primer ({len(reverse_primer)} nt): 5'-{reverse_primer}-3'\")\n        print(f\"Forward Tm: {fw_tm:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Reverse Tm: {rev_tm:.2f}°C\")\n        print(f\"Tm difference: {abs(fw_tm - rev_tm):.2f}°C\")\n        \n        # Write to FASTA file\n        with open('primers.fasta', 'w') as f:\n            f.write(\">forward_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(forward_primer + \"\\n\")\n            f.write(\">reverse_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(reverse_primer + \"\\n\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()","filePath":"/app/design_primers_v3.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/design_primers_v3.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/design_primers_v3.py","time":{"start":1789612866987,"end":1789612866992}},"id":"prt_0ad3d0cb20011sBM2QLylRroed","sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","messageID":"msg_0ad3d05ee001RpKtH2T3ZwSoyR"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1789612881360,"sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"tooluse_anV4PYIwI9XnE7rQ5sPESU","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\ndef reverse_complement(seq):\n    \"\"\"Generate reverse complement of DNA sequence\"\"\"\n    complement = {'A': 'T', 'T': 'A', 'G': 'C', 'C': 'G', 'a': 't', 'g': 'c', 't': 'a', 'c': 'g'}\n    return ''.join(complement[base] for base in reversed(seq))\n\ndef approximate_tm(sequence):\n    \"\"\"Calculate melting temperature\"\"\"\n    seq = sequence.upper()\n    \n    # Wallace rule for short sequences, Marmur-Doty for longer\n    if len(seq) < 14:\n        gc_count = seq.count('G') + seq.count('C')\n        at_count = seq.count('A') + seq.count('T')\n        tm = 2 * at_count + 4 * gc_count\n    else:\n        gc_count = seq.count('G') + seq.count('C')\n        if len(seq) > 0:\n            tm = 64.9 + 41.0 * (gc_count / len(seq)) - 675.0 / len(seq)\n        else:\n            tm = 0\n    \n    return tm\n\ndef design_sdm_primers(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq):\n    \"\"\"\n    Design primers for Site-Directed Mutagenesis\n    The forward primer must contain the insertion mutation\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    # For SDM, forward primer should:\n    # 1. Contain the mutation (insertion)\n    # 2. Be 15-45 nt long  \n    # 3. Have Tm between 58-72°C\n    # 4. Have reverse primer within 5°C\n    \n    # Since the insertion is 39nt, we need to be strategic\n    # Option 1: Use the insertion + small flanking regions\n    # Let's use ~3nt upstream + full insertion + ~3nt downstream = 45nt total\n    \n    upstream_flank = 3\n    downstream_flank = 3\n    \n    # Extract flanking sequences\n    upstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos - upstream_flank:insertion_pos]\n    downstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos:insertion_pos + downstream_flank]\n    \n    # Create forward primer (may exceed 45nt due to large insertion)\n    forward_primer = upstream_seq + insertion_seq + downstream_seq\n    \n    # If too long, we'll truncate intelligently\n    if len(forward_primer) > 45:\n        # Keep full insertion but limit flanking regions\n        max_flanking = (45 - len(insertion_seq)) // 2\n        upstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos - min(max_flanking, 3):insertion_pos]\n        downstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos:insertion_pos + min(max_flanking, 3)]\n        forward_primer = upstream_seq + insertion_seq + downstream_seq\n    \n    # Design reverse primer (typically 15-25nt, binds downstream of mutation)\n    # For large insertions, bind further downstream\n    reverse_primer_start = insertion_pos + len(insertion_seq) + 10\n    reverse_primer_end = reverse_primer_start + 20\n    \n    # Boundary check\n    if reverse_primer_end <= len(input_seq):\n        reverse_primer_template = input_seq[reverse_primer_start:reverse_primer_end]\n        reverse_primer = reverse_complement(reverse_primer_template)\n    else:\n        # Fallback: bind closer\n        reverse_primer_start = max(0, len(input_seq) - 20)\n        reverse_primer_end = len(input_seq)\n        reverse_primer_template = input_seq[reverse_primer_start:reverse_primer_end]\n        reverse_primer = reverse_complement(reverse_primer_template)\n    \n    # Calculate Tm values\n    fw_tm = approximate_tm(forward_primer)\n    rev_tm = approximate_tm(reverse_primer)\n    \n    return {\n        'forward': forward_primer,\n        'reverse': reverse_primer,\n        'fw_tm': fw_tm,\n        'rev_tm': rev_tm,\n        'fw_length': len(forward_primer),\n        'rev_length': len(reverse_primer),\n        'tm_diff': abs(fw_tm - rev_tm)\n    }\n\ndef main():\n    # Read the input sequence\n    with open('sequences.fasta', 'r') as f:\n        lines = f.readlines()\n    \n    input_seq = ''\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        if line.startswith('>input'):\n            input_seq = lines[i+1].strip()\n            break\n    \n    # Identify the insertion\n    insertion_pos = 215\n    insertion_seq = \"tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag\"  # 39 nucleotides\n    \n    print(\"Designing primers for site-directed mutagenesis\")\n    print(f\"Insertion position: {insertion_pos}\")\n    print(f\"Insertion length: {len(insertion_seq)} nucleotides\")\n    print(f\"Insertion sequence: {insertion_seq}\")\n    \n    # Design primers\n    primers = design_sdm_primers(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq)\n    \n    print(f\"\\nPrimer design results:\")\n    print(f\"Forward primer ({primers['fw_length']} nt): {primers['forward']}\")\n    print(f\"Reverse primer ({primers['rev_length']} nt): {primers['reverse']}\")\n    print(f\"Forward Tm: {primers['fw_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n    print(f\"Reverse Tm: {primers['rev_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n    print(f\"Tm difference: {primers['tm_diff']:.2f}°C\")\n    \n    # Check if primers meet requirements\n    meets_length = 15 <= primers['fw_length'] <= 45 and 15 <= primers['rev_length'] <= 45\n    meets_tm = 58 <= primers['fw_tm'] <= 72 and 58 <= primers['rev_tm'] <= 72\n    meets_tm_diff = primers['tm_diff'] <= 5\n    \n    print(f\"\\nRequirements check:\")\n    print(f\"Primer lengths within 15-45nt: {'Yes' if meets_length else 'No'}\")\n    print(f\"Melting temperatures within 58-72°C: {'Yes' if meets_tm else 'No'}\")\n    print(f\"Tm difference ≤ 5°C: {'Yes' if meets_tm_diff else 'No'}\")\n    \n    # Verify the insertion is in the forward primer\n    insertion_present = insertion_seq in primers['forward']\n    print(f\"Insertion present in forward primer: {'Yes' if insertion_present else 'No'}\")\n    \n    # Write to FASTA file with primers grouped by pairs\n    with open('primers.fasta', 'w') as f:\n        f.write(\">forward_primer\\n\")\n        f.write(primers['forward'] + \"\\n\")\n        f.write(\">reverse_primer\\n\")\n        f.write(primers['reverse'] + \"\\n\")\n    \n    print(f\"\\nDesigned primers have been saved to primers.fasta\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()","filePath":"/app/final_primer_design.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/final_primer_design.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/final_primer_design.py","time":{"start":1789612881353,"end":1789612881358}},"id":"prt_0ad3d5071001k8tAnL4XYSsK2V","sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","messageID":"msg_0ad3d4a56001mMHpAkOGSIi03a"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1789612895395,"sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"tooluse_cFvPXeoTXSU3U4ZjxQDYlL","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\ndef reverse_complement(seq):\n    \"\"\"Generate reverse complement of DNA sequence\"\"\"\n    complement = {'A': 'T', 'T': 'A', 'G': 'C', 'C': 'G', 'a': 't', 'g': 'c', 't': 'a', 'c': 'g'}\n    return ''.join(complement[base] for base in reversed(seq))\n\ndef approximate_tm(sequence):\n    \"\"\"Calculate melting temperature using improved method\"\"\"\n    seq = sequence.upper()\n    \n    if len(seq) == 0:\n        return 0\n    \n    # Use nearest-neighbor parameters for better accuracy\n    if len(seq) < 14:\n        # Wallace rule for short sequences\n        gc_count = seq.count('G') + seq.count('C')\n        at_count = seq.count('A') + seq.count('T')\n        tm = 2 * at_count + 4 * gc_count\n    else:\n        # Modified Marmur-Doty for longer sequences\n        gc_count = seq.count('G') + seq.count('C')\n        tm = 64.9 + 41.0 * (gc_count / len(seq)) - 675.0 / len(seq)\n    \n    return max(0, tm)  # Ensure non-negative\n\ndef find_optimal_primers(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq):\n    \"\"\"Find optimal primer pair that meets all constraints\"\"\"\n    \n    best_primers = None\n    best_score = float('inf')\n    \n    # Try different configurations to meet Tm requirements\n    # Forward primer: upstream + insertion + downstream (total length constrained)\n    # Reverse primer: varies in position and length to optimize Tm\n    \n    # Since insertion is 39nt, forward primer will be dominated by it\n    for upstream_len in range(2, 5):  # Small upstream flanking region\n        for downstream_len in range(2, 5):  # Small downstream flanking region\n            # Create forward primer\n            upstream_start = insertion_pos - upstream_len\n            if upstream_start < 0:\n                continue\n                \n            upstream_seq = input_seq[upstream_start:insertion_pos]\n            downstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos:insertion_pos + downstream_len]\n            forward_primer = upstream_seq + insertion_seq + downstream_seq\n            \n            # Check length constraint\n            if not (15 <= len(forward_primer) <= 45):\n                continue\n            \n            fw_tm = approximate_tm(forward_primer)\n            \n            # If forward primer Tm is out of range, skip\n            if not (58 <= fw_tm <= 72):\n                continue\n            \n            # Try different reverse primer positions and lengths\n            for rev_distance in range(5, 30):  # Distance from insertion site\n                for rev_length in range(15, 26):  # Reverse primer length\n                    rev_start = insertion_pos + len(insertion_seq) + rev_distance\n                    rev_end = rev_start + rev_length\n                    \n                    # Check bounds\n                    if rev_end > len(input_seq):\n                        continue\n                    \n                    reverse_primer_template = input_seq[rev_start:rev_end]\n                    reverse_primer = reverse_complement(reverse_primer_template)\n                    \n                    rev_tm = approximate_tm(reverse_primer)\n                    \n                    # Check all constraints\n                    if not (15 <= len(reverse_primer) <= 45):\n                        continue\n                    \n                    if not (58 <= rev_tm <= 72):\n                        continue\n                    \n                    tm_diff = abs(fw_tm - rev_tm)\n                    if tm_diff > 5:\n                        continue\n                    \n                    # Score: prefer Tms close to 65°C, primer lengths around 25nt\n                    score = (abs(fw_tm - 65) + abs(rev_tm - 65) + \n                            abs(len(forward_primer) - 25)/5 + \n                            abs(len(reverse_primer) - 25)/5 +\n                            tm_diff)\n                    \n                    if score < best_score:\n                        best_score = score\n                        best_primers = {\n                            'forward': forward_primer,\n                            'reverse': reverse_primer,\n                            'fw_tm': fw_tm,\n                            'rev_tm': rev_tm,\n                            'fw_length': len(forward_primer),\n                            'rev_length': len(reverse_primer),\n                            'tm_diff': tm_diff\n                        }\n    \n    return best_primers\n\ndef main():\n    # Read the input sequence\n    with open('sequences.fasta', 'r') as f:\n        lines = f.readlines()\n    \n    input_seq = ''\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        if line.startswith('>input'):\n            input_seq = lines[i+1].strip()\n            break\n    \n    # Identify the insertion\n    insertion_pos = 215\n    insertion_seq = \"tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag\"  # 39 nucleotides\n    \n    print(\"Designing primers for site-directed mutagenesis with NEB Q5 Kit\")\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n    print(f\"Insertion position: {insertion_pos}\")\n    print(f\"Insertion length: {len(insertion_seq)} nucleotides\")\n    \n    # Find optimal primers\n    primers = find_optimal_primers(input_seq, insertion_pos, insertion_seq)\n    \n    if primers:\n        print(f\"\\nOptimal primer pair found:\")\n        print(\"-\" * 40)\n        print(f\"Forward primer ({primers['fw_length']} nt):\")\n        print(f\"  Sequence: 5'-{primers['forward']}-3'\")\n        print(f\"  Tm: {primers['fw_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n        \n        print(f\"\\nReverse primer ({primers['rev_length']} nt):\")\n        print(f\"  Sequence: 5'-{primers['reverse']}-3'\")\n        print(f\"  Tm: {primers['rev_tm']:.2f}°C\")\n        \n        print(f\"\\nTm difference: {primers['tm_diff']:.2f}°C\")\n        \n        # Verify requirements\n        requirements_met = (\n            15 <= primers['fw_length'] <= 45 and\n            15 <= primers['rev_length'] <= 45 and\n            58 <= primers['fw_tm'] <= 72 and\n            58 <= primers['rev_tm'] <= 72 and\n            primers['tm_diff'] <= 5\n        )\n        \n        print(f\"\\nAll requirements met: {'Yes' if requirements_met else 'No'}\")\n        \n        # Confirm insertion is included\n        insertion_included = insertion_seq in primers['forward']\n        print(f\"Insertion correctly included: {'Yes' if insertion_included else 'No'}\")\n        \n        # Write to FASTA file\n        with open('primers.fasta', 'w') as f:\n            f.write(\">forward_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(primers['forward'] + \"\\n\")\n            f.write(\">reverse_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(primers['reverse'] + \"\\n\")\n        \n        print(f\"\\n✅ Primers written to primers.fasta\")\n        \n    else:\n        print(\"❌ Could not find primer pair meeting all requirements.\")\n        print(\"Generating closest possible alternative...\")\n        \n        # Generate alternative with relaxed constraints\n        upstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos-3:insertion_pos]\n        downstream_seq = input_seq[insertion_pos:insertion_pos+3]\n        forward_primer = upstream_seq + insertion_seq + downstream_seq\n        \n        # Trim if too long\n        if len(forward_primer) > 45:\n            forward_primer = forward_primer[:45]\n        \n        # Reverse primer\n        rev_start = insertion_pos + len(insertion_seq) + 15\n        rev_end = rev_start + 20\n        if rev_end <= len(input_seq):\n            reverse_primer_template = input_seq[rev_start:rev_end]\n        else:\n            # Fallback to end of sequence\n            rev_end = len(input_seq)\n            rev_start = max(0, rev_end - 20)\n            reverse_primer_template = input_seq[rev_start:rev_end]\n            \n        reverse_primer = reverse_complement(reverse_primer_template)\n        \n        # Write to file\n        with open('primers.fasta', 'w') as f:\n            f.write(\">forward_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(forward_primer + \"\\n\")\n            f.write(\">reverse_primer\\n\")\n            f.write(reverse_primer + \"\\n\")\n        \n        print(f\"Alternative primers written to primers.fasta\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()","filePath":"/app/optimize_primers.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/optimize_primers.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/optimize_primers.py","time":{"start":1789612895384,"end":1789612895392}},"id":"prt_0ad3d8264001rzpPrVwA2YacO6","sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","messageID":"msg_0ad3d7c0a001WqxeMqH7AKoIYx"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1789612909913,"sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"tooluse_o39dlKX3jmYzb1oxLLGD2r","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\ndef reverse_complement(seq):\n    \"\"\"Generate reverse complement of DNA sequence\"\"\"\n    complement = {'A': 'T', 'T': 'A', 'G': 'C', 'C': 'G', 'a': 't', 'g': 'c', 't': 'a', 'c': 'g'}\n    return ''.join(complement[base] for base in reversed(seq))\n\ndef approximate_tm(sequence):\n    \"\"\"Calculate melting temperature\"\"\"\n    seq = sequence.upper()\n    \n    if len(seq) == 0:\n        return 0\n    \n    if len(seq) < 14:\n        # Wallace rule for short sequences\n        gc_count = seq.count('G') + seq.count('C')\n        at_count = seq.count('A') + seq.count('T')\n        tm = 2 * at_count + 4 * gc_count\n    else:\n        # Modified Marmur-Doty for longer sequences\n        gc_count = seq.count('G') + seq.count('C')\n        tm = 64.9 + 41.0 * (gc_count / len(seq)) - 675.0 / len(seq)\n    \n    return max(0, tm)\n\ndef validate_primers():\n    \"\"\"Validate the final primer design\"\"\"\n    \n    # Read primers from the output file\n    with open('primers.fasta', 'r') as f:\n        lines = f.readlines()\n    \n    forward_primer = lines[1].strip()\n    reverse_primer = lines[3].strip()\n    \n    # Calculate Tm values\n    fw_tm = approximate_tm(forward_primer)\n    rev_tm = approximate_tm(reverse_primer)\n    \n    # Print validation report\n    print(\"PRIMER DESIGN VALIDATION REPORT\")\n    print(\"=\" * 40)\n    print(f\"Forward primer: 5'-{forward_primer}-3'\")\n    print(f\"Length: {len(forward_primer)} nucleotides\")\n    print(f\"Melting temperature: {fw_tm:.2f}°C\")\n    print()\n    print(f\"Reverse primer: 5'-{reverse_primer}-3'\")\n    print(f\"Length: {len(reverse_primer)} nucleotides\")\n    print(f\"Melting temperature: {rev_tm:.2f}°C\")\n    print()\n    print(f\"Tm difference: {abs(fw_tm - rev_tm):.2f}°C\")\n    print()\n    \n    # Check requirements\n    print(\"REQUIREMENTS CHECK\")\n    print(\"-\" * 20)\n    \n    # Length requirements (15-45 nt)\n    len_check = 15 <= len(forward_primer) <= 45 and 15 <= len(reverse_primer) <= 45\n    print(f\"✓ Primer lengths (15-45 nt): {'PASS' if len_check else 'FAIL'}\")\n    \n    # Tm requirements (58-72°C)\n    tm_check = 58 <= fw_tm <= 72 and 58 <= rev_tm <= 72\n    print(f\"✓ Melting temperatures (58-72°C): {'PASS' if tm_check else 'FAIL'}\")\n    \n    # Tm difference requirement (≤5°C)\n    tm_diff_check = abs(fw_tm - rev_tm) <= 5\n    print(f\"✓ Tm difference (≤5°C): {'PASS' if tm_diff_check else 'FAIL'}\")\n    \n    # Insertion presence check\n    insertion_seq = \"tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag\"\n    insertion_check = insertion_seq in forward_primer\n    print(f\"✓ Insertion correctly incorporated: {'PASS' if insertion_check else 'FAIL'}\")\n    \n    # Overall result\n    all_checks = len_check and tm_check and tm_diff_check and insertion_check\n    print()\n    print(f\"OVERALL RESULT: {'ALL REQUIREMENTS MET' if all_checks else 'SOME REQUIREMENTS NOT MET'}\")\n    \n    return all_checks\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    validate_primers()","filePath":"/app/validate_primers.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/validate_primers.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/validate_primers.py","time":{"start":1789612909906,"end":1789612909911}},"id":"prt_0ad3dd088001YIj3IRTCMwKh5k","sessionID":"ses_f52c3d1ecffe0kK7wSf3Ho3bNg","messageID":"msg_0ad3dc9bd001uim1v75Q9mMGMf"}}
